meta.description: The ORVIBO Motion Sensor works with the Zigbee Mini gateway: it detects people and pets, turns on the night light at night, switches off the AC and TV after you leave and alerts you while you're away.
meta.spec.description: ORVIBO Motion Sensor specifications: 2 AAA batteries, Zigbee HA, IEEE 802.15.4 at 2.4 GHz, AES-128 encryption.
alt.banner: The ORVIBO Motion Sensor on a desk. With the Zigbee Mini gateway, it detects people or pets on the move.
alt.features: Standard Zigbee ZHA protocol, works with smart devices from major platforms, fast 10 ms response.
alt.rooms: Several sensors together sense every room in the house: fit them in the living room, bedroom and kitchen and link them to your other smart devices.
alt.night: Up at night, the night light comes on by itself: the sensor by the bed turns on a smart switch or light.
alt.delay: Delayed shut-off for the AC and TV: a while after everyone leaves the living room, an IR blaster turns them off.
alt.away: Alerts while you're away: when the sensor detects someone, your phone gets an alert and the camera starts recording.
alt.mount: The sensor mounted high on a wall on its bracket. It detects across 120° and up to 8 m.
alt.install: Tool-free install in three steps: put in the batteries and stick the sensor in place, install the app and add the device, then link it to other devices.
alt.app: The ORVIBO Home app, free for iOS and Android, with scenes such as a light that turns on with motion.
alt.screens: ORVIBO Home app screens: devices by room, the motion sensor and the profile. The app brings family sharing, scenes and security.
